messages.en:
Ever since you left, it's
been a ghost town here!
messages.et:
Sinu lahkumisest saati on
siin nagu kummituslinn!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 11 00} is all the
rage right now!

The {04 11 00} fest
is going on here!

You should visit again!
It's Dullsville without you!
messages.et:
Sa peaksid jälle tulema!
Ilma sinuta on igav!

messages.en:
Would you teach me about
{04 12 00} next?

I can't keep up with all
the {04 12 00} stats.
messages.et:
Ma ei jõua {04 12 00}
statistikaga järge pidada.

Kas sulle meeldib {04 13 00}?
Mul on seda palju.

messages.en:
I drank {04 14 00}
and it was smooth.

If you want to see me
again, just holler at me!
messages.et:
Kui tahad mind jälle
näha, lihtsalt hõika!

messages.en:
Thank you for visiting. I
got you a present.
messages.et:
Aitäh külaskäigu eest.
Sain sulle kingituse.

messages.en:
This is a symbol of our
friendship. Do you like it?
messages.et:
See on meie sõpruse
märk. Kas meeldib?

messages.en:
I got this for you. I hope
you like it.
messages.et:
Sain selle sulle. Loodan,
et see meeldib.

messages.en:
I chose this, you know.
I hope you like it.
messages.et:
Ma valisin selle ise.
Loodan, et meeldib.

messages.en:
A homebody like you
should appreciate this.
messages.et:
Selline kodukana nagu sina
peaks seda hindama.

messages.en:
Here's a gift for you.
Enjoy it!
messages.et:
Siin on sulle kingitus.
Naudi seda!
